correctness.rationale: Let q=p^d be the smallest prime power exceeding r>=2. Lucas congruence gives f(n)=C(n,r) mod p with period q, so (zeros mod q, count mod p) is a complete p*q DFA. Every state is reachable by 0^r 1^t 0^(N-r). For any two states, suffix blocks 1^k 0 1^k... give affine hyperplanes with coefficient vectors f(a+j); equality of right languages requires proportional coefficient vectors. Their supports have trivial cyclic translation stabilizer because r is in support but r-q/p is not (highest Lucas digit decreases), forcing same a and then same t. Hence every reachable state is distinguishable for every acceptance residue c; sc=p^(2+floor(log_p r)). Independent partition refinement checked all residues in 15 (p,r) choices across p=2,3,5 and tested support translations; the infinite argument is Myhill-Nerode plus Lucas, not the sample.
